# CyberScryb
> Free AI writers, life-document tools, and browser developer utilities

CyberScryb is a solo-built toolkit for freelancers, caregivers, and builders.
- Local browser tools (JSON, password, Base64, etc.) process data only on your device.
- AI writers (Humanizer, Gig Auto-Pilot, letters, detectors) send input to an AI backend for that one generation step; results are not stored as training data on our side.
- 100% Free with zero paywalls, zero accounts, and no subscriptions.

## Flagship AI tools

- [AI Humanizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/humanizer/): Rewrite stiff ChatGPT paste so it sounds human
- [Gig Auto-Pilot](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/gig-auto-pilot/): Job post → freelance proposal + draft
- [AI Writing Suite](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-writing-suite/): Detect AI patterns and fix flagged sentences
- [Curator Prime](https://curator.cyberscryb.com): Photo → name, brand, value range, care notes
- [AI Text Summarizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/summarizer/)
- [AI Email Writer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/email-writer/)
- [AI Paraphraser](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/paraphraser/)
- [AI Detector](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-detector/)
- [Prompt Battle](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/prompt-battle/): Pick the stronger prompt in rounds of 8, then build your own with a live checklist. The game stays in the browser and does not call an AI.
- [AI or Human? The Writing Test](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-or-human-writer/): Read a passage and say whether a person or an AI wrote it. Public-domain excerpts and the best score stay in the browser. No AI call.

## Life / legal letter tools

- [Hardship Letter Writer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/hardship-letter/)
- [Utility Shutoff Letter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/utility-shutoff-letter/)
- [Insurance Denial Appeal](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/insurance-denial-appeal/)
- [Appeal Letter Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/appeal-letter/)
- [Caregiver Shift Report](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/caregiver-report/)
- [Custody & Parenting Plan](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/custody-document/)
- [Budget Planner](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/budget-planner/)
- [Subscription Leak Calculator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/subscription-leak-calculator/): Add up subscriptions, spot overlaps, and see what to cut. Browser only.
- [Screen Time Reality Check](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/screen-time-reality-check/): Turn daily screen hours into a week, a year, and a lifetime, with a reclaim slider and a small plan. Hours stay in the browser.
- [Notification Detox Planner](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/notification-detox-planner/): Sort app pings into Keep, Batch, or Silence, with quiet hours and a 7-day checklist. The plan stays in the browser.
- [Build Your Dream Setup](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/dream-setup-builder/): Pick a use and a budget, then add generic desk pieces. The estimate, ergonomics score, and vibe stay in the browser.

- [Landlord & Tenant Letters](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/landlord-tenant-letter/)
- [Payment Demand Letter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/payment-demand-letter/)

## Developer utilities (local)

- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/json-csv-converter/)
- [JSON Formatter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/json-formatter/)
- [SEO Meta Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/seo-tag-generator/)
- [Password Strength Checker](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/password-checker/)
- [Is This Link Safe](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/is-this-link-safe/): Paste a link for a plain-language reading of lookalike domains and other red flags. The address stays in the browser.
- [Phishing Inbox Simulator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/phishing-inbox-simulator/): Mark fictional emails safe or phish and read the real link address. Answers stay in the browser.
- [Spot the Scam Call](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/spot-the-scam-call/): Play fictional phone calls as text, hang up or reply, and read the red flags. No audio. Answers stay in the browser.
- [Would You Click It?](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/would-you-click-it/): Click or skip fictional popups, ads, downloads, and permission prompts, then read what gave each one away. The pictures are inert. Answers stay in the browser.
- [Choose Your Own Hack](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/choose-your-own-hack/): A branching story where you are the target of a fictional scam. Choices and endings stay in the browser.
- [Tech Myth or Fact](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/tech-myth-or-fact/): Swipe Myth or Fact on tech claims and read a short explanation. Score and seen claims stay in the browser.
- [Which Tech Era Are You?](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/which-tech-era/): Twelve questions about notes, phones, music, and fixes. The result is one of seven eras, a tech soulmate, and a match across every era. The last result stays in the browser.
- [What's Your Internet Personality?](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/internet-personality/): Fourteen scenes about tabs, group chats, comments, shopping, and terms. The result is one of eight types, a privacy tip, and a blend across every type. The last result stays in the browser.
- [Guess the Year: Tech Edition](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/guess-the-year/): Drag a year onto tech milestones, then see the gap and a one-line fact. Daily mode deals the same ten cards from the UTC date. Scores stay in the browser.
- [Emoji Translator Challenge](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/emoji-translator-challenge/): Decode an emoji string into a phrase, or turn a sentence into emoji with a local word list. Daily mode deals the same ten puzzles from the UTC date. Scores stay in the browser.
- [Password Habit Quiz](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/password-habit-quiz/): Twelve questions about password habits, a score, and a prioritized fix-it plan. No password is asked for. The last result stays in the browser.
- [How Long to Crack It?](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/how-long-to-crack-it/): Compare crack time for a rate-limited login, one GPU, a GPU cluster, and bcrypt. The estimate stays on the device and is never sent.
- [Digital Footprint Check](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/digital-footprint/): A private checklist of social, people-search, location, photo, breach, device, and app exposure. No name or email is asked for. The cleanup checks stay in the browser.
- [Base64 Tool](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/base64-tool/)
- [Regex Tester](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/regex-tester/)
- [Cron Builder](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/cron-builder/)
- [Hash Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/hash-generator/)
- [JWT Decoder](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/jwt-decoder/)
- Full catalog: https://cyberscryb.com/tools/
